cohort: 1,747 women who gave birth vaginally in Zhejiang Province, China
finding: The Chinese version of the Childbirth Experience Questionnaire (CEQ-C) was found to be a reliable and valid tool for measuring childbirth experiences among Chinese women in facility settings.
mod_finding: While this study examined the validity of a childbirth experience questionnaire and identified delivery mode as a factor influencing childbirth experiences, it did not directly analyze specific outcomes related to different modes of delivery.
